property_summary: After calling newAddressProposal then newGrantProposal then cancelProposal(1,2), the reference contract sets proposalCount to 1 (since newAddressProposal incremented it to 1, then newGrantProposal incremented it to 2, but cancelProposal only resets old votes, so proposalCount stays 2 because no revert occurs), while the buggy contract leaves proposalCount at 1 because newAddressProposal did not increment, leading cancelProposal to execute without revert and proposalCount remains 1 — but the actual divergence occurs earlier: after the two proposal creation calls, in the reference proposalCount == 2, in the buggy proposalCount == 1; then calling cancelProposal(1,2) succeeds in both, but the final proposalCount values differ (2 vs 1).
change_summary: Delete the line that increments proposalCount in newAddressProposal.
